description: This file contains tests for the provider authentication choices manifest helpers, utilizing the Vitest testing framework. It includes mock setup, helper functions for creating plugin manifests and provider auth choices, and multiple test cases that check the logic of flattening manifest auth choices, resolving deprecated choices, deduplicating CLI flags, and handling untrusted workspace plugins during onboarding.
